desc: Quickly and easily mount your Harris style bipod to your M-LOK handguard with the Yankee Hill Machine Bipod Mount. This M-LOK mount features the familiar sling swivel stud required to attach many of the high end precision bipods on the market today. Its precision machined from aircraft grade aluminum with a mil-spec hard anodized finish. When you need top quality parts and components for your next AR build, turn to Yankee Hill Machine!
